question: How do weights and biases relate to learning in a neural network?
direct_answer: Training updates them to reduce the loss.
expanded_answer: The learning algorithm computes gradients of the loss with respect to weights and biases, then adjusts them so predictions improve. So weights and biases are the learned quantities, while gradient descent or Adam is the method used to learn them.
key_points: Training changes parameters based on loss
Gradients tell how to update them
The optimizer is separate from the parameters
common_wrong_ideas: Weights and biases are the optimizer
